title: decode.rs Step 2 comment says 'possible for Base64' but is also possible for QP
description: decode.rs line 119: comment says 'either the decoded output itself exceeded max_bytes (possible for Base64, where the input limit rounds up to the next multiple of 4)'. QP can also produce more decoded bytes than max_bytes since the 4x multiplier is a bound, not exact. The parenthetical '(possible for Base64...)' is misleading. Remove or generalize the parenthetical to say 'this can occur for any encoding where input is pre-truncated at a loose bound'.
